gaps: Season history: no opening or closing dates found for 2022, 2023 or 2024, and no closing date for 2025. All dates found come from tour operators, not from the administration or newspapers.
The 2026 opening date differs between operators (1 May and 15 May), as does the September 2026 reopening (15, 18 and 20 September).
Permit fee, validity and the exact document list are not on the official portal's front page; documents listed come from operators.
Jolingkong altitude: the district page gives 4,572 metres in its text and 4,770 metres in its table.
No highway number found; the road name comes from a newspaper headline seen in search results.
Uttarakhand green cess: the exemption for two-wheelers is reported by two news outlets; no Transport Department order or official page was found.
Own motorcycles beyond Dharchula: three unofficial guides disagree and no order from the district administration was found. Rider videos show motorcycles on the Dharchula to Gunji road.
The rider guide on own motorcycles shows no printed date; 2025 is taken from the addresses of its images.
Videos: titles and channels were read from the video pages; filming dates and motorcycles are not confirmed.
Some stretch distances are doubtful. The open map may not know the road riders use, so the routing service went the long way round.
